registeredBy: Sam (owner); no run made before this file was committed
hypothesis: An AR (lag 0-13 by BIC) on monthly y/y inflation, for the one or two months after the newest published figure, has a lower RMSE than carrying the newest figure on.
knownLimits: Values are today's vintage (later revisions included); no real-time data vintages are free for all countries, so this is a pseudo real-time test.
No timelier price indicator is used: this is a short-range projection from inflation itself.
OECD series only; the national series the app splices on for recent months are not in the test.
